answers.answer_text: He was often disturbed at his work by the telephone.

answers.answer_text: His application is already processed.

answers.answer_text: Is your car badly damaged?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Die Karten für die Oper sind schon reserviert.

answers.answer_text: The tickets for the opera are already reserved.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Der Bericht ist schon geschrieben.

answers.answer_text: There's too much smoking in this room.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hier wird oft bis spät abends gearbeitet.

answers.answer_text: Work often goes on here until late in the evening.

questions_and_answers.question_text: In dieser Gegend wird viel Wein getrunken.

answers.answer_text: There's a lot of wine drunk in this part of the country.

questions_and_answers.question_text: In unseren Schulen wird viel Sport getrieben.

answers.answer_text: There's a lot of athletics in our schools.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bei uns wird abends gewöhnlich kalt gegessen.

answers.answer_text: Supper is usually a cold meal at our house.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Mir wurde gesagt, dass er seinen Urlaub in den Bergen verbringt.

answers.answer_text: I was told that he's spending his vacation in the mountains.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dass die Siegessäule früher in der Nähe des Reichstagsgebäudes stand, wurde mir schon erzählt.

answers.answer_text: I was told that the Victory Column previously was located in the vicinity of the Reichstag building.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ihr wurde geschrieben, dass sie im Juni in Bonn erwartet wird.

answers.answer_text: Someone wrote to her that she is expected in Bonn in June.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wurde ihm gesagt, dass die Tagung in der Kongresshalle stattfindet?

answers.answer_text: Was he told that the meeting is going to be at the Congress Hall?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ihm wurde ausgerichtet, dass er die Theaterkarten bei der Anmeldung abholen soll.

answers.answer_text: He was told that he is to pick up the tickets at the hotel desk.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wollen wir zum Brandenburger Tor weiterfahren?

answers.answer_text: Shall we drive on to the Brandenburg Gate?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Der Berliner Zoo gefällt mir.

answers.answer_text: I like the Berlin Zoo.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Haben Sie das berühmte Bremer Rathaus schon gesehen?

answers.answer_text: Have you seen the famous Bremen Town Hall yet?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Der Schweizer Käse ist in vielen Ländern bekannt.

answers.answer_text: Swiss cheese is well known in many countries.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er wollte gern eine Auskunft über die Bonner Universität haben.

answers.answer_text: They didn't begin to rebuild it until after the war.

answers.answer_text: Not until shortly before the conference did it occur to him that he had forgotten the important documents.

answers.answer_text: Not until 1963 did we have a chance to go to the industrial exposition.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wir werden ihn erst im August wiedersehen.

answers.answer_text: We won't see him again until August.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Erst am Wochenende werden wir uns in der Stadt umsehen können.

answers.answer_text: Not until the weekend will we be able to look around town.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Man muss die Studenten auch deutsch buchstabieren lassen.

answers.answer_text: The students have to be made to spell in German too.

answers.answer_text: He'll be heard from again.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Man vergisst das leider viel zu schnell.

answers.answer_text: That is much too quickly forgotten unfortunately.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Diese Ausstellung muss man sehen.

answers.answer_text: This exhibition has to be seen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Man kann viel über diese Aufführung lesen.

answers.answer_text: A lot can be read about this performance.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Man hat viel über diesen Artikel gesprochen.

answers.answer_text: There was a lot of talk about this article.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zollbeamte können einem viele Schwierigkeiten machen.

answers.answer_text: Customs officials can make a lot of trouble for a person.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dieses Buch kann einem viele neue Ideen geben.

answers.answer_text: This book can give a person lots of new ideas.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Damit ist einem nicht viel geholfen.

answers.answer_text: A person isn't helped much by that.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Der Betrieb hier kann einem leicht zuviel werden.

answers.answer_text: The hustle and bustle here can get to be too much for a person.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Im Sommer wird es einem hier oft zu warm.

answers.answer_text: In the summer it often gets too warm for a person here.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das Klingeln des Telefons kann einen oft bei der Arbeit stören.

answers.answer_text: The ringing of the telephone often can disturb you at work.

questions_and_answers.question_text: In einer kleinen Stadt kennen einen die meisten Leute.

answers.answer_text: In a small town most people know you.

questions_and_answers.question_text: So ein Leben kann einen berühmt oder berüchtigt machen.

answers.answer_text: A life like that can make you famous or infamous.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kinder fragen einen oft zu viel.

answers.answer_text: Children often ask you too much.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bei diesem schlechten Wetter erwartet einen keiner.

answers.answer_text: In this bad weather no one expects you.

answers.answer_text: One must pay his rent generally at the beginning of the month.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Es ist billiger wenn man seine Ferngespräche nach sieben Uhr abends macht.

answers.answer_text: It's cheaper if one makes his long distance calls after seven o'clock in the evening.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hier kann man sein Geld wechseln lassen.

answers.answer_text: One can get his money changed here.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Der Betriebsleiter ist nicht mehr zu erreichen.

answers.answer_text: The plant manager can no longer be reached.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Drei Geschäftsbriefe sind noch zu diktieren.

answers.answer_text: There are still three business letters to be dictated.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jetzt sind noch die Kisten aus dem Keller zu holen.

answers.answer_text: Now the crates still have to be fetched from the cellar.
